map.个人年度盘点：录入通勤里程、用电用气、饮食结构与消费次数，定位排放大头。: Personal annual inventory: enter commuting mileage, electricity and gas use, diet structure and consumption frequency to locate the biggest emission sources.
map.交通 = 私家车×0.192 + 公交×0.089 + 短途航班×0.255 +: Transport = private car×0.192 + bus×0.089 + short flight×0.255 + long flight×0.195 (kg/km, by kilometres); energy = electricity×0.583 (kg/kWh) + natural gas×2.04 (kg/m³); diet by annual value (vegetarian 100 / basic vegetarian 150 / little meat 250 / average 330 / high meat 500 kg) divided by 12 for monthly; takeaway 1.5 kg per order, shopping 5 kg per order, new clothes 25 kg per item (annual value divided by 12). Rating: <2000 kg low carbon, <5000 kg in line with the global average, <8000 kg slightly high, otherwise high. Offset estimate: trees = ⌈annual emissions/21⌉ trees (about 21 kg absorbed per tree per year), photovoltaics = ⌈annual emissions/1300⌉ kW (about 1300 kg reduced per kW per year).
